subject: [PATCH 3/5] KVM: guest_memfd: bind backing memory to a NUMA node at creation

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch adds a new flag called GUEST_MEMFD_FLAG_BIND_NODE to the KVM guest memory file descriptor (memfd) feature. When this flag is set, the backing memory for the guest is bound to a specific NUMA node at creation time, rather than being allocated through a shared mempolicy that can be modified later. This change requires CONFIG_NUMA to be enabled and only allows binding to nodes within the calling task's cpuset. The policy is fixed for the life of the fd and cannot be rebound on later cpuset changes.
